controls.title: Runtime events use the EventHub API
controls.rationale: EventHub provides a governed event contract, lifecycle isolation, and observability that global window events cannot provide.
controls.remediation: Replace window.dispatchEvent and window.postMessage integration events with runtimeApi.eventHub.publish.

controls.title: Runtime localStorage keys are application scoped
controls.rationale: Portal and application identifiers prevent collisions when several applications share one browser origin.
controls.remediation: Prefix keys as portal:application:key or use the runtime storage adapter.

controls.title: Migrate applications away from React 16
controls.rationale: React 16 support is being retired from the managed web runtime, and legacy root APIs are common migration blockers.
controls.remediation: Plan a supported React upgrade and replace ReactDOM.render or ReactDOM.hydrate with modern root APIs.

verification.description: Verify the resolved React and react-dom versions are outside the React 16 range.

controls.title: Runtime applications use CDaaS managed hosting
controls.rationale: Content Gateway and Jules configuration are being retired in favor of one managed hosting path.
controls.remediation: Remove Content Gateway dependencies and Jules configuration, then onboard the application to CDaaS managed hosting.

verification.description: Run the Content Gateway and Jules deprecation rules.
Confirm the CDaaS deployment is registered and healthy before removing the prior hosting path.

controls.title: Use the supported runtime development environment
controls.rationale: A separate local web harness can diverge from runtime lifecycle, routing, identity, and EventHub behavior.
controls.remediation: Use the runtime platform's supported development environment and connection workflow.
